effect: War and sabotage damage to power plants now costs money to repair. When a plant is hit, its owner's treasury pays the added damage x capacity (GW) x the game's own capital cost for that technology (GC capex, e.g. nuclear 6 bn$/GW) x the local build-cost multiplier (t7A), as a treasury expense (purpose war_repair, booked through the same payment the game uses for plant decommissioning). The treasury pays as the game's other payments do (borrowing for a shortfall when it can); if it cannot (e.g. in default), it pays the cash it has and the repair takes longer: each hit adds the unpaid share of the repair time for the damage it caused, and the total never exceeds twice the game's repair time for the plant's damage. A fully destroyed 1.4 GW reactor costs its owner about 8 bn$ instead of nothing. The money leaves the economy (no construction firm receives it): war destroys value. Oil and gas fields are not charged (the game has no capital cost for them). Day 0 unchanged (no damage at start). (Minified names in this text are those of build 26296134; the patch's find text has the current ones.)
